P01.rationale: No founder or person portrait is used as a dominant human anchor; the left column contains only a QR code and a text testimonial block, with no actual photograph of a person.

P05.rationale: There is no named client portrait at any meaningful size; the image area in the left column shows only a QR code, leaving a clear gap where a portrait should be.

P07.rationale: A single pull-quote testimonial with attribution is present, but there is no press/logo wall, rating cards, or review grid — only a minimal quote block.

P10.rationale: A large opening quotation mark glyph (66) appears in the testimonial area, but there are no giant ghost numerals or other oversized decorative typographic elements.

P11.rationale: Three concrete before/after data points (24h→minutes, >200,000€, 4 processes) are displayed in a prominent dark stat bar, providing real number-bound results, though no charts or cost-math visualisations are used.

P12.rationale: The lower half of the page is noticeably under-filled with large empty white space below the final paragraph, giving the layout a sparse rather than magazine-dense feel.

P13.rationale: The background is entirely flat white with no texture, atmosphere, or tonal treatment applied anywhere on the page.

P14.rationale: No full-bleed photo is used on this page, so the criterion is not applicable; score reflects absence of the device.

P16.rationale: No device or product mockup (phone, laptop, book, etc.) appears anywhere on the page.

N07.rationale: The only visual element is a generic QR code rather than a real, specific business or person photograph, making the imagery feel placeholder-generic rather than credibly specific.

N08.rationale: A large dead-white region occupies roughly the bottom quarter of the page below the 'Ergebnis' section, representing significant purposeless empty space.

N10.rationale: No text is placed over a busy photo without a scrim; all text sits on clean white backgrounds with no awkward overlaps.
